# AL1701: Avoid DateTime/DateTimeOffset time accessors

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Usage` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1701AvoidDateTimeNowAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

DateTime.Now/UtcNow and DateTimeOffset.Now/UtcNow make code difficult to test. Use TimeProvider.System.GetLocalNow() or GetUtcNow() instead, which can be mocked in tests.
